fusions.name: Weight on One Claw
fusions.desc: Puts your whole weight behind one claw, dealing 30 damage, plus 6% of the target's maximum health if it is a boss or elite, and leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Thorn in the Paw
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health: a swipe across a 3-tile cone ahead of you that deals 9 damage to everything in it. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Guard-Hairs Up
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and leaves them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Woken Sore
fusions.desc: When a blow that is not fire lands on you, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
